messages:
julia: Quick feedback on compact trace drilldown: where to put correlation ID and export button? header vs inline metadata. Also dark-mode error badge contrast low.
devin: Header preferred for consistency. Use explicit copy label: 'Copy correlation ID'.
sam: Header simplifies keyboard order. If inline, tabindex per metadata row gets messy. Export should be a dropdown: 'Export trace ▾' -> JSON / CSV.
linda: Contrast: error badge in dark theme is ~2.6:1, fails AA. Options: stronger color, 1px outline, or add icon+text. Also ensure pill focus ring is obvious.
julia: For stack traces propose 'Show 6 more frames' collapsed row with aria-expanded toggle. Screen reader text: 'button, collapsed, Show 6 more frames'.
devin: Copy for toggle: 'Show 6 more frames' / 'Hide extra frames' and aria-expanded.
sam: Impl note: lazy-render frames on expand to avoid reflow.
linda: Make tooltips accessible: tooltip text = 'Copy correlation ID' not just 'Copy'. Announce toast 'Correlation ID copied to clipboard'.
julia: I'll update Figma and send small spec. Thanks!
